official_documentation.name: Claude Code Settings Reference
official_documentation.relevance: Complete settings key listing with each key's Scope line. Use it to confirm the precedence order (managed > CLI flags > local > project > user), which lock class a key belongs to (managed-only, any-scope but enforced only from managed, any-scope where managed wins), update-control keys, and retention defaults and minimums.

official_documentation.name: OpenAI Codex Configuration Reference
official_documentation.relevance: Codex config key reference: approval and sandbox values, project-ignored keys, experimental context-management and memory settings with their plan requirements, and the skill catalog budget key with its default and explicit cap. Look up current values here before writing config.
